terms.title: Terms of use
terms.summary: The rules DeRechi runs by: a free board of lost and found notices. By posting a notice you agree to them.

sections.heading: 1. What DeRechi is
body: DeRechi helps people who lost something and people who found something find each other. The service is free, needs no registration and shows no ads. The site is run by {operator}.
We don't keep items, don't act as a go-between in handing them over and take no commission. The owner and the finder arrange the return themselves.

sections.heading: 2. Posting notices
body: Anyone can post a notice. It needs the item's title, category, date, place and your phone and email; a found notice needs a photo as well. If you are under 14, ask a parent to post the notice for you.
By posting a notice you confirm that:
you describe a real loss or find, not an advert for goods or services, a test of demand or a sale of what you found;
the contacts you give are your own, not someone else's;
you have the right to the text and photo you publish;
you post each item once, without duplicates.
Notices must not contain:
other people's personal data, including document numbers and pages of documents with personal details;
photos of official IDs or documents of state bodies, the military or law enforcement;
links to other websites;
calls to violence, or propaganda of war or extremism;
insults, discrimination, obscene or erotic content;
spam, scams and pyramid schemes, or any other illegal or misleading content.
The date of the loss or find must be no more than 30 days ago.

sections.heading: 3. Using the site
body: Without our written permission you may not collect notices automatically (with bots or scrapers), interfere with how the site works, or use contacts from notices for anything other than returning an item, such as advertising.

sections.heading: 4. Contacts
body: Your phone and email are only partly visible on a notice, to keep you safe from spam.

Anyone who recognises the item can send the notice's author their own contacts through the site. We pass them on by email and SMS and never show them publicly. By sending your contacts you confirm that they are your own and that you contact the author about this item only.

sections.heading: 5. Rights to content
body: The text and photo of your notice remain yours. By publishing them you let us show them on the site free of charge for as long as the notice is published.
The DeRechi name, the site's design and its code belong to the operator.

sections.heading: 6. Finds and rewards
body: {findersLaw}
A reward stated in a notice is the author's offer. DeRechi doesn't guarantee it is paid and takes no part in any payment.

sections.heading: 7. Safety
body: Before handing an item over, ask the owner to describe details the photo doesn't show. Meet in busy places.

Never pay in advance to someone who says they found your thing, and never give anyone your card details or SMS codes. DeRechi is free and never asks for payment or for such data: anyone who does is a scammer. In case of fraud, contact the police and let us know at {email}.
DeRechi doesn't verify users' identity and isn't responsible for what they do when they meet.

sections.heading: 8. Changing and removing notices
body: You can't edit a notice yourself yet. Once the item is back, close the notice with the link in the message we send after someone responds to it, or write to {email}. To correct a notice, also write to {email}.
We may remove a notice that breaks these terms or the law, or strip personal data from it, without warning. To report a breach in someone else's notice, also write to {email}.

sections.heading: 9. Liability
body: The service is provided “as is”. We don't guarantee that an item will be found and aren't responsible for the accuracy of notices: their authors are.
We aren't responsible for interruptions, technical failures or loss of data caused by circumstances beyond our control.

sections.heading: 10. Disputes
body: {governingLaw}

sections.heading: 11. Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms. The date of the latest version is shown at the top of the page. By using the site after a change you accept the new version.
Send questions about these terms to {email}.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.summary: What data DeRechi collects, why, who can see it and how you control it. {dataLaw}

sections.heading: 1. Who processes the data
body: The controller of personal data is {operator}. For anything about your data, write to {email}.

sections.heading: 2. What we collect
body: When you post a notice:
the item: title, description, category, date, photo and the reward, if you set one;
the place: the name and coordinates of the point you picked or found by location;
your contacts: phone number, email address and the messengers you ticked.
When you respond to someone else's notice:
your contacts: the phone number, email address and messengers you send to the notice's author.
We have no accounts or passwords, so we keep no other data about you.
Don't put information about health, religion, biometrics or other sensitive data in a notice, about yourself or anyone else.
When you visit the site, the server, like any web server, may record technical details of the request, such as the IP address, browser type and time, to protect against abuse.

sections.heading: 3. What others can see
body: The item's description, the place with its coordinates and the photo are public. The phone and email on a notice are only partly shown (for example, +38067*****67); messengers aren't shown at all.
Contacts you send in response to a notice are shown only to that notice's author, in the message we send them, and are never published.

sections.heading: 4. Why we use the data
body: to show your notice to other people and let them find it by search;
to pass your contacts to the author of the notice you responded to;
to remind both sides to close the notice once the item is back;
to protect the site from spam and abuse.
The legal basis is your consent, which you give by posting a notice or by responding to one.

sections.heading: 5. Location
body: On the found items page and in the notice form the site may ask for your location. You can refuse: everything works without it.

For the nearby search, the coordinates are rounded to about 100 m and passed in the page address for that search only; we don't store them. In the notice form, the coordinates become the notice's place and are published with it.

sections.heading: 6. Third-party services
body: Google Maps Platform: address suggestions and looking up an address from coordinates in the notice form; what you type into the place field, and the coordinates, are sent to Google;
Vercel BotID: checks that the form is sent by a person, not a bot;
These services process data under their own privacy policies, including in other countries. We don't sell your data or pass it to advertisers.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies and browser storage
body: We use only what is necessary:
the DERECHI_LOCALE cookie: remembers your language for a year;
the DERECHI_COUNTRY cookie: remembers your country for a year, to show the right currency and legal texts;
DERECHI_CLAIM_* cookies: remember for an hour that you have responded to a notice.
There are no analytics or advertising cookies on the site.

sections.heading: 8. How long we keep data
body: A notice is kept until it is taken down. After that it moves to an archive and is no longer shown on the site.

Contacts sent in response to a notice are kept until that notice is closed, and for one year at most. A notice with responses is closed when either side confirms that the item is back, or about a week after the last response.

sections.heading: 9. Your rights
body: {rightsBasis}
know what data of yours we process and get access to it;
ask for inaccurate data to be corrected or deleted;
withdraw your consent to processing;
{complaintRight}
To use these rights, write to {email}.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy. The date of the latest version is shown at the top of the page.
